description: This file defines the AttendanceRecord class within the OrangeHRM system, representing an employee's attendance punch-in and punch-out records, with related metadata such as timestamps, notes, time zones, and state. It includes ORM annotations for database mapping and uses traits and decorators for additional functionality.

classes.name: AttendanceRecord
classes.description: Represents an employee's attendance punch record, including timestamps, notes, timezone info, and state, mapped to the 'ohrm_attendance_record' database table.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the attendance record.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the attendance record.

methods.name: getEmployee
methods.description: Retrieves the Employee associated with this attendance record.

methods.name: setEmployee
methods.description: Associates an Employee with this attendance record.

methods.name: getPunchInUtcTime
methods.description: Gets the punch-in time in UTC.

methods.name: setPunchInUtcTime
methods.description: Sets the punch-in UTC time.

methods.name: getPunchInNote
methods.description: Retrieves the note associated with punch-in.

methods.name: setPunchInNote
methods.description: Sets the note for punch-in.

methods.name: getPunchInTimeOffset
methods.description: Gets the time offset applied during punch-in.

methods.name: setPunchInTimeOffset
methods.description: Sets the time offset for punch-in.

methods.name: getPunchInUserTime
methods.description: Retrieves the user local time at punch-in.

methods.name: setPunchInUserTime
methods.description: Sets the user local time at punch-in.

methods.name: getPunchOutUtcTime
methods.description: Gets the punch-out time in UTC.

methods.name: setPunchOutUtcTime
methods.description: Sets the punch-out UTC time.

methods.name: getPunchOutNote
methods.description: Retrieves the note associated with punch-out.

methods.name: setPunchOutNote
methods.description: Sets the note for punch-out.

methods.name: getPunchOutTimeOffset
methods.description: Gets the time offset applied during punch-out.

methods.name: setPunchOutTimeOffset
methods.description: Sets the time offset for punch-out.

methods.name: getPunchOutUserTime
methods.description: Retrieves the user local time at punch-out.

methods.name: setPunchOutUserTime
methods.description: Sets the user local time at punch-out.

methods.name: getState
methods.description: Returns the current state of the attendance record.

methods.name: setState
methods.description: Sets the state of the attendance record.

methods.name: getPunchInTimezoneName
methods.description: Retrieves the timezone name used during punch-in.

methods.name: setPunchInTimezoneName
methods.description: Sets the timezone name for punch-in.

methods.name: getPunchOutTimezoneName
methods.description: Retrieves the timezone name used during punch-out.

methods.name: setPunchOutTimezoneName
methods.description: Sets the timezone name for punch-out.
